text:
DevOps Bot: Pager: billing-metering token-count drift detected for embed/encode pipeline — auto-page oncall.
BillingBot: Detected: token-count delta = -18% for window 01:00-02:00 UTC vs expected. Also 12 overage flags queued for customers A,B,C. (rule: >10 in 5m)
Alice Meyer: I'm oncall, taking it. starting investigation — pinging infra + billing.
Mike Kim: Looking at emitter logs and consumer offsets.
Sara Patel: Quick note: backfill microbatch for ingest-3 is delayed, backlog growing.
Jordan Lee: Can someone paste the 1h reconcile diff? I want to see sign of late reports vs duplicate emissions.
Mike Kim: ```
# quick delta from internal metrics
{"expected_tokens":1502000, "observed_tokens":1225000, "delta_pct":-18.4}
# consumer offsets: consumer-3 gap at seq 104532 -> 104999, retry-loop observed
```
Alice Meyer: Thanks. That suggests late ingestion causing undercount earlier, then a duplicate-retry later causing spikes and late reconcilation — triggers overage flags when ledger applied.
BillingBot: Note: delayed usage batch (batch-id: u/2026-03-18T02Z) is still pending processing; ETA 00:20.
Sara Patel: Mitigation proposal: 1) Pause automated overage notifications for affected customers, 2) Force reconcile in dry-run to estimate true deltas, 3) Apply consumer offset fix and restart emitter in staged canary.
Alice Meyer: Agreed. I'm pausing auto-notify now: `billing.actions.pause_overage_notify --tag incident/7087654321`.
Jordan Lee: I'll run the dry-run reconcile and post summary.
Mike Kim: Patching consumer-3 now to apply offset fix (will do canary on 1 node then roll).
CS Bot: Heads-up: Drafting a customer-safe comms template in #customer-success, tagging top affected accounts.
Alice Meyer: If dry-run shows net zero or negative impact, we'll mark incident as reduced customer-impact. Otherwise, prepare credits and post-mortem.
Jordan Lee: Dry-run done — estimated net change after applying pending batch: +0.2% overall, but 3 accounts flip from flagged->ok.
Alice Meyer: Good. Re-enable emitter with patch rolled to 50% canary. Watching.
Mike Kim: Canary looks clean, offsets align, late batch processed. Over the next 15m watch for any new flags.
BillingBot: Overage flags queue dropped to 0 after reconcile and pause. No new alerts in last 300s.
Alice Meyer: Reopening automated notify with threshold hold for 1h to avoid flapping. Will file postmortem.
Sara Patel: Filing follow-up: investigate why backfill delayed — possible Kafka consumer lag + GC spike on ingest-3.
Alice Meyer: Thanks all. Assigning owners: Mike (emitter fix), Sara (backfill root cause), Jordan (billing reconcile), CS to draft customer comms. Closing pager for infra. :white_check_mark:
CS Bot: Customer comm sent to affected accounts with optional credit offer.
Alice Meyer: Incident closed — will create postmortem link when available.
